_comment: Dependabot opens ONE PR PER DEPENDENCY. The website repo has 30+ open, and real reviews drown in them: a security fix and a patch bump look identical in the list, so both get ignored. Renovate BATCHES them, so the queue is short enough to actually read. Security updates stay separate and immediate - those are the ones that must never be batched away.

packageRules.description: Batch all non-major updates into ONE weekly PR. This is the whole point.
Majors stay separate. Astro 4 -> 7 is not a rubber-stamp.
The tools that guard the legal document are never auto-bumped without a human.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix is NOT batched. It gets its own PR, immediately, at any hour.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
